identification: Omega Seamaster Quartz gent's wristwatch, cal. 1342 (Omega's first-generation 7-jewel quartz, c.1976-82), 196.0xxx family. About 35-36mm round steel case, knurled coin-edge bezel with a gilt inner ring, black dial with a faceted/segmented 'pie-pan' sunburst pattern, applied baton indexes, date at 3, centre seconds. Screw-down steel caseback with gold-coloured Seamaster hippocampus medallion and '1342' stamped below it. Grey leather strap with gilt buckle in photos 1 and 3; photo 2 (caseback) shows a black perforated rubber strap, so the strap was changed between photos (or two straps come with it). Catalogue does not say working.

viewing_check: Ask if it runs (or bring a fresh battery: cal 1342 takes a 1.55V silver oxide cell); check the second hand steps and the date changes; read the caseback inside reference 196.0xxx if staff will open it; crystal scratches; bezel gilt wear; crown original with Omega logo; ask whether both straps come with it.
